question: How does teacher predictive uncertainty select voxel-level consistency while student optimization and teacher parameter averaging retain distinct objects and supervision domains?

element_groups: Labeled/unlabeled input identity, source-specific perturbations, student/teacher parameter states and predictions.
Same teacher and same volume, stochastic probability samples, pass mean, class entropy and strict per-voxel selector.
Labeled-only joint cross-entropy/Dice and selected-voxel squared consistency over both training sets.

source_relations.meaning: Parameter EMA differs from T stochastic teacher predictions; mean probabilities over passes before entropy over classes.
Strict entropy threshold selects the squared-discrepancy numerator and selected-count denominator.
Joint CE+Dice; dropout on in training/uncertainty, off in testing; T8, alpha0.99; distinct lambda warm-up and binary H range.
Standard UA-MT consistency uses both training sets; the unlabeled-only variant is not silently substituted.

visual_design: A separates prediction and labeled supervision; B orders probability mean, entropy and selection; C expands the selected ratio; D separates student optimization and teacher EMA. Explicit aliases retain one scientific entity across panels. Native math scripts preserve summation domains; labeled-only text sits inside its owning loss box.
transferable_rules: Name update objects and aggregation axes before sharing a visual metaphor: teacher parameters, MC probabilities and uncertainty scores are distinct.
Preserve noncommuting operation order, selection comparator and denominator; unknown empty-set behavior stays unknown.
Keep source-standard training domains separate from reported comparison variants.
Do not identify a teacher consistency target with an MC mean without source support, or infer target correctness from low entropy.
Editable mathematics needs checked script attachment and actual native baselines, not only flattened text matching.
gaps: Teacher consistency target f-prime versus MC probability mean numerical/call relationship unspecified; neither equality nor inequality is asserted.
Empty-selected-set implementation, exact standalone H(t), perturbation draw dependence, teacher initialization/within-step ordering and test model/checkpoint are not specified by inspected evidence.
Shared student drawing is a network-role abstraction, not proof of one identical stochastic call for both losses.
Source v1 versus formal full-text equivalence, training code/weights/data/outputs unverified; low entropy is not calibrated correctness and increasing H does not prove monotone accepted counts.
No new heldout case, human expert review or clinical validation, GUI/browser/editor/physical-print or journal-specific acceptance in this batch.
